cream.descriptionHtml:
A breakthrough Korean daily moisturizing cream, powered by NAD+ and 8 other actives, that helps reverse visible signs of aging, recharges skin cells, fades blemishes, and boosts collagen. Results in just 4–8 weeks, leave your skin firmer, plumper, smoother and deeply nourished.

50 ML / 1.69 FL OZ

features.text: Visibly Firmer, Brighter Skin Every Day
Powered by NAD+ Cellular Technology for Deep Repair
Reverses Stress Induced Aging from Late Nights & Burnout

details.title: Key Benefits
details.html:
• Restores - Recharges tired skin at the cellular level
  • Hydrates - Delivers 5 layers of deep, lasting moisture
  • Shields - Strengthens the barrier against stress & damage
  • Plumps - Fills fine lines for firmer, bouncier skin

details.title: How to Use
details.html: After cleansing, swipe a JIYU Toner Pad across skin to prep and treat. Then apply a pearl-sized amount of the NAD+ Cream to face and neck, massaging gently in upward motions until fully absorbed. Use morning and night for best results. Follow with sunscreen during the day.

details.title: Where to Use
details.html: Apply anywhere you want firmer, brighter, more youthful-looking skin. Perfect for face, neck, and décolleté. It's just as effective on the chest, shoulders, and hands, where signs of aging, dark spots, and crepey skin tend to show up first. The NAD+ cellular technology and 5-layer Hyaluronic Acid work on contact, so every area you apply gets the same firming, smoothing, and hydrating benefits.

details.title: 9 Active Ingredients
details.html:
Formulated with 9 powerful actives:

  • NAD+ – supports skin renewal, smooths fine lines & boosts radiance
  • 5-Layer Hyaluronic Acid – delivers deep, long-lasting hydration & plumps skin
  • Cassia Angustifolia Seed Polysaccharide – helps balance, soothe & comfort tired skin
  • Niacinamide – brightens dull skin & evens overall tone
  • 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C derivative) – enhances radiance & targets dark spots
  • Ferulic Acid – provides antioxidant protection & supports skin brightness
  • Ceramide NP – strengthens the skin barrier & locks in moisture
  • Shea Butter – deeply nourishes & prevents moisture loss
  • Sunflower Seed Wax – seals hydration & improves skin resilience

toner.descriptionHtml:
A breakthrough daily toner, packed with 8 Korean actives like Niacinamide, Snail Mucin & Peptides, JIYU's toner pads visibly fade spots, refine texture, and boost elasticity — swipe daily or leave on for targeted treatment. Get results in just 4–8 weeks, leaving your skin firmer, plumper, smoother and deeply nourished.

150 ML / 5.07 FL OZ, 100 Pads

features.text: 100 Pads Per Jar for Lasting Use
Soaked in a Hypoallergenic Gentle Formula

details.title: Key Benefits
details.html:
• Brightens - Fades dark spots & blemishes
  • Tightens - Gently lifts sagging skin
  • Smooths - Plumps to smooth wrinkles
  • Firms - Reduces the look of crepey skin

details.title: How to Use
details.html: After cleansing, swipe one pad gently across the skin, avoiding the eye area. Use twice daily - morning and night, for best results. Leave the essence on, no rinsing needed. You can also leave the toner pads on for 15 minutes as a targeted treatment mask. For max results, follow with our to lock in the actives, treat and protect. .

details.title: Where to Use
details.html: Apply anywhere you want smoother, brighter, more even-toned skin. Perfect for face, neck, and décolleté. They're just as effective on the chest, shoulders, and hands - anywhere dark spots, rough texture, or dullness tend to show up first. The exfoliating + hydrating pads work on contact, so every area you treat gets the same brightening, smoothing, and resurfacing benefits.

details.title: 8 Active Ingredients
details.html:
Formulated with 8 powerful actives:

  • Niacinamide – brightens & evens tone
  • Peptides – support elasticity & firmness
  • Snail Mucin – hydrates & soothes
  • Centella Asiatica – calms redness
  • Vitamin C derivative – boosts radiance
  • Hyaluronic Acid Complex – locks in moisture
  • Alpha-Arbutin – fades dark spots
  • Licorice Root Extract – repairs and soothes

bundle.descriptionHtml:
Renewal Toner Pads + NAD+ Moisturizing Cream Bundle. The ultimate Korean skincare duo for transformative anti-aging results. Best used together: Toner Pads exfoliate and prep, NAD+ Cream restores and repairs at the cellular level for visibly younger, radiant skin.

Moisturizer: 50 ML / 1.69 FL OZ
Toner: 150 ML / 5.07 FL OZ, 100 Pads

features.text: Exfoliate, Brighten, Hydrate and Lock in Cellular Repair
Designed to Work Together for Best Results

details.title: Key Benefits
details.html:
• Brightens - Fades dark spots & evens skin tone
  • Firms - Lifts, tightens, and reduces the look of crepey skin
  • Restores - Recharges tired skin with NAD+ cellular repair
